lines.text: Paul considers our present sufferings not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
The creation waits eagerly for the revelation of the angels of heaven, in hope of being set free from decay.
The whole creation groans in childbirth pains, and we wait patiently for what we do not yet see.
In our weakness, Christ Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
God works all things together for good for those who love Him, and those He justified, He also glorified.
